name: Spokes
description: Spokes is the simple, fully-featured self-hosted alternative to popular cloud chat apps. A powerful chat platform that runs entirely on your own infrastructure. Easy control and ownership of your data.

paths.name: App Data Path
paths.description: Persistent data folder where configuration all Spokes data is stored.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: The port for the Spokes Web UI interface.

ports.name: Voice TCP Fallback Port
ports.description: LiveKit TCP fallback port for voice traffic. Must be mapped 1-to-1.

ports.name: Voice UDP Port Range
ports.description: LiveKit UDP port range for voice/video traffic. Must be mapped 1-to-1.

variables.name: Master Password
variables.description: Required. The master password used to securely encrypt the escrow keys for Public and Team channels. Do not lose this password!
